summary:
Implemented and validated search rebuild performance improvements. Rebuilder invoice scans are now tenant-scoped, embeddings use bounded concurrency and 100-item chunks, the management command shares its embedding client, and vector upserts share one transaction. A 5,000-invoice rebuild dropped from 8.42s to 1.19s; a 10,000-document benchmark reached 2.41s median versus 16.73s previously. Added a unique `(tenant_id, document_id)` migration (`0042`); full suite passes: 247 passed, 4 skipped. Search tests all pass. A separate CSV export encoding test still fails: 1 failed, 6 passed. Keep commits small.

Production rollout has completed steps 1–5. The rc.2 canary deployment (`payments-api-rc3-canary`, 2 replicas) was created; next update it to rc.3 and continue steps 6–8. Active schema is `billing_v3`; `billing_v1` is frozen for finance and must never be written to. Before modifying `ledgerly/migrations/`, contact @dana-db in `#prod-db-changes`.

Double-counted refunds in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py` remain uninvestigated. New Sentry issues require `[billing] ...` titles and `ledgerly:<exception-type>:<handler-or-worker>` fingerprints.
